Things I've built

Shipped, and still in progress.

Solo developer · 2026 – present

MetaVault

A Magic: The Gathering app for scanning cards, tracking what your collection is worth, building decks, and running Commander games. I built all of it solo: web, iOS, and backend.

Live on the App StoreLive on the web
meta-vault.appApp Store

  • Card scanning

    Apple Vision reads the card, then a fuzzy match against Scryfall finds it in seconds.

  • Apple Wallet passes

    Your collection as a Wallet pass, refreshed every night with signed APNs pushes.

  • Live life tracker

    Real-time game sync for the whole table, with life graphs and game history.

  • Deck builder

    Builds a Commander deck from cards you own, using EDHREC and Commander Spellbook data.

  • Backend

    Supabase Postgres with row-level security, edge functions, and nightly cron jobs.

  • App Store review

    Rejected twice, fixed both, shipped. 700+ tests run in CI.

Personal project · 2026

Video game mashups

Characters and game modes from other games, playable inside Elden Ring. Built in Rust with AI coding agents and posted on TikTok and X.

It started with Overwatch's Doomfist. Now there's Dragon Ball FighterZ, Cyberpunk's Sandevistan, Halo, and more, each built to play like the original.

Xbox Labs

Xbox started Xbox Labs in October 2026 as a direct response to the wave of AI-built mods and ports. eXputer's coverage of the launch listed my Doomfist in Elden Ring mod as one of those projects. VGTimes also covered my eight-game Elden Ring shooter clip in its roundup of the trend.

Watch on TikTokWatch on X
  • 24M+TikTok views in under a month
  • 7.5Mimpressions on X
  • 6.9Mviews on the top clip
  • 914Kshares on TikTok

  • Pulling assets out of each game

    I wrote my own readers for each game's files to get the models, animations, sounds, and HUD art.

  • My code, Elden Ring's world

    Abilities, physics, cameras, and HUDs run in my Rust code. Elden Ring supplies the world.

  • On TikTok so far

    Overwatch, Halo, Dragon Ball FighterZ, Cyberpunk 2077, Resident Evil 2, Zelda in VR, and a Tesla Roadster.
